doc: subtexel = None and a scalar streak 0.4 (the shield texture is a constant), offset 0.3 as a python float (a scalar offset, not an array): the branches of compose the typical case does not take, through the solver. 64x32 float32 fields. Tolerance as the typical case. Arguments: s, fine, target, streak, subtexel and offset are the inputs of that name when listed; an unlisted streak or offset (default 0.0) is the scalar in params, an unlisted subtexel is None; prm holds the GenParams fields compose reads. The 36 steps and the bracket [-10, 10] are literals of the source. Measured: promoting the float32 inputs to float64 changes the output by at most 1.0e-8; one-ulp nudges of every float input and parameter change it by at most 7.0e-8 (worst of 6 random trials); the tolerance is about 1e2x the larger of the two spreads.
